directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write on the topic Changes in the Way of Communication. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
The way of communication has witnessed significant changes over the years. To begin with, the traditional face-to-face communication has been supplemented by various digital means. In the past, people had to meet each other in person to have a conversation. However, now we can use video calls on platforms like WeChat or Zoom, which is especially useful when we are far away from our friends and family.

In addition, the speed of communication has increased dramatically. Letters used to take days or even weeks to reach the recipient, while an email or a text message can be sent and received within seconds. This has made it much easier to keep in touch with others and share information promptly.

Furthermore, the scope of communication has expanded. Social media platforms such as Facebook and Twitter allow us to connect with people from all over the world. We can join groups based on our interests and communicate with like-minded individuals.

In conclusion, these changes in the way of communication have brought more convenience and efficiency to our lives, making the world a smaller and more connected place.
